events.title: Movie Monday – The Librarians (2025)
events.description:
In honor of “Every Story Matters” week (a.k.a Banned Books Week), please join us for a showing of this award-winning 2025 documentary about the current fight for the freedom to read and to keep libraries open in the US.

Light refreshments provided, courtesy of the Friends of the Mountain View Library.

Recommended for ages 14 and up due to language and adult themes.

Anyone who requires an auxiliary aid or service for effective communication, or a modification of policies or procedures to participate in a program, service, or activity should contact library staff as soon as possible. Advance requests 48 hours or more before the event are encouraged, but not required. All programs are subject to change.

events.description:

events.title: Lauhala Weaving Class
events.description:
As the regional branch of Maui County, Kahului Library is actively working to preserve, promote, and perpetuate Hawaiian culture by collaborating with local cultural practitioners. Join us for a lauhala weaving class led by Leiana Sing-Keliikoa. Accompanied by special guests, Leiana will be instructing us in the ancient Hawaiian practice of lauhala weaving. This is an advanced class; some experience required. Suitable for adults and teens. 

Program begins promptly at 1:00pm and is scheduled to run until 3:00pm.

Registration required; limited to 6 attendees per class. 1 reservation per person.
Be advised that failure to show up on time may forfeit your reservation.

RSVP below.

events.title: Mid-Autumn Festival
events.description:
Celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival with us! Keiki and families are invited to learn about the festival, make your own lantern, and make your own Mooncakes for the tea party! Welcoming ages 5+. Young children must be accompanied by an adult caregiver. This free event requires advanced registration. Please register online or call the library (808-323-7585) if reservation assistance is needed. 

This program is generously sponsored by Friends of the Libraries, Kona (F.O.L.K.) 

Anyone who requires an auxiliary aid or service for effective communication, or a modification of policies or procedures to participate in a program, service, or activity should contact library staff as soon as possible. Advance requests 48 hours or more before the event are encouraged, but not required. Program schedule is subject to change.

events.title: Family Story Time
events.description:
Join us for Family Story Time every Tuesday morning! Come join us for fun stories, dances, and songs.

There will be a free new book given to child participants the first story time of every month until December 2026. First come, first served. Thank you to the Pahoa Promise Partnership for their generous donations.

Program is suitable for age 2 and over. All children must be accompanied by a parent or an adult caregiver.

Anyone who requires an auxiliary aid or service for effective communication, or a modification of policies or procedures to participate in a program, service, or activity should contact library staff as soon as possible. Advance requests 48 hours or more before the event are encouraged, but not required. Program schedules are subject to change. Events will not be held on State holidays.

events.description:

This program is sponsored by the Friends of the Library Kapolei.

Grab a Seat and Join the Fun!

events.title: Keiki Movie Monday
events.description:
Join us for Keiki Movie Monday this fall break!

Animal lover Mabel uses clever new technology designed to “hop” human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals to communicate with beavers, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

This movie is rated PG and 105 minutes long. Light refreshments will be provided while supplies last. Outside food is permitted.

Sponsored by the Friends of Kalihi-Pālama Public Library.

events.title: Craft: Galaxy Space Ship
events.description:
Galactic Fun awaits you on Monday, October 5th at Mililani Public Library. Using supplies provided by the library, Children ages 5 and up can create their own flying Galaxy Ships, using supplies provided by the library. (While supplies last). When completed, this aircraft will be able to glide through the air. (12:30-1:15pm)

Then, join us for the movie showing of The Super Mario Galaxy Movie (Rated PG) and watch as Mario and Luigi team up with Princess Peach to travel across galaxies in order to save Princess Rosalina from the powerful villain Bowser Jr. (1:30-3:15pm)
